subject: Process ownership — Shipping CS Monday board
body:
Hi all,

Who currently owns the Monday board for shipping CS? I need to update some access permissions and want to make sure I route the request to the right person.

If there's a process-ownership doc somewhere I missed, point me at it.

Thanks,
Ops Director

expected_outcome.notes: Internal process-ownership question. The supplied Active source (SOP-08) does NOT identify the board owner, so the engine may NOT claim one: it drafts a NEUTRAL holding reply making no ownership claim, pending Ops Manager approval (role derived from the M1 mock routing packet REF-03; holder looked up in the mock Org Chart REF-04). Any draft asserting an unsupported owner is rejected by the deterministic internal-governance audit and escalates with draft=null.
